name: linux-only-signed-updates-apply
purpose: On linux, a correctly signed newer release is applied without administrator rights and keeps the endpoint id; a badly signed one is refused and the running version stays.

given.text: the HashRelay cloud is running with workspace w1
the HashRelay agent is installed per user on linux, by a non-administrator
the agent is paired to workspace w1 through the device-authorization flow as endpoint e1
release 2.0.1 signed with the HashRelay publisher identity and release 2.0.2 signed with a foreign key are in the release channel

when.text: the agent checks the release channel

then.text: release 2.0.2 is refused for its signature
agent 2.0.1 is running after the update, without an administrator prompt
the endpoint id is still e1
